title: director_plan
description: The director's plan for one edit: one idea, a structure with the reason it was chosen, and the shots, each with its purpose, its technique and the moment wanted. The code editor executes it without changing shots and answers with a short report; the director may then answer with notes (max 2 rounds). Written by the director (an OpenRouter model, or the host agent in agent mode), read by the editor and shown in plain words in the Director tab.

shot_ref.description: shot key from shotlog.json: <clip counter>/<segment id>, e.g. 0081/s7, or <photo>/p1 for a photo

idea.description: one sentence: what this edit is about and what the viewer should feel

kind.description: the structure chosen from the menu in prompts/director.md

why.description: why this structure fits this subject and message, in plain words

beats.description: the story beats in order; the sum of target_s should be the target duration

intent.description: what this beat does for the story

id.description: slot id: v1, v2, ... in timeline order

purpose.description: what this shot does in the story (its job), in plain words

technique.description: the technique from the catalogue in prompts/director.md; none when the shot is just a plain cut

pieces.description: jerky_approach and time_compression only: how many short pieces of the take

moment.description: the moment the cut should be built around; the editor keeps the good part of the shot around it

hint.description: the moment in words, when the director has no timecode, e.g. 'the boat passes the gate'

target_s.description: how long the shot should be on screen; the editor keeps it within 2 to 5 s by clip length unless the technique needs otherwise

why.description: why this shot, here, in plain words (shown in the Director tab)

notes.description: anything the editor should know, and the owner's notes the plan follows
